name: interaction-types
label: Interaction types
description: The kind of interaction between two drugs. Pharmacokinetic types say which step of ADME is affected; pharmacodynamic types describe what happens at the target.

terms.label: Antidote / reversal agent
terms.note: Added in 1.5. Previously there was no way to record that N-acetylcysteine answers NAPQI, so the fact sat in prose on the NAPQI record.

terms.label: Pharmacodynamic — additive CNS depression
terms.note: Split out from pd-synergism in 1.5. Sedative stacking is the single most common serious pairing in an OTC-plus-hypnotic set and deserves to be queryable on its own.

terms.label: Pharmacokinetic — transporter
terms.note: Added in 1.5 for P-gp. Distinct from metabolism: a P-gp inhibitor can change where a drug goes without changing how fast it is cleared.
